name: ai.ckrets/ckrets
title: ckrets
description: One-time secret tokens for agents: create a token and URL that reveal a value once; status, revoke, limits; deliver into an env var or a 0600 file, never into the conversation.

environmentVariables.name: CKRETS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A ckrets key or lease (ck_live_…); without it, the anonymous tier

environmentVariables.name: CKRETS_SINKS
environmentVariables.description: Where deliver_secret may write: env:NAME, file:/path or file:/dir/, comma-separated

environmentVariables.name: CKRETS_ALLOW_REVEAL_IN_CONTEXT
environmentVariables.description: true lists reveal_secret, which returns a value into the conversation (off by default; prefer deliver_secret)
